scope: 0PN, same radius-one cubic mouth, intake 0.25; cold twelve-site mobile-neighbor response and signed waist-to-middle force following a prescribed first-bend hold.
material_assumptions: Cold planar isolated neighborhood, same-layer Morse law, unit overdamped drag per site against the material reference. After removing cross bonds only for calibration, the sites re-equilibrate. In the segment all nine contacted members share a passing packet with prescribed phase offsets. Different packets have no direct bonds. For each macroscopic traction component the two planar directional copies receive the same contact force, and their mean displacement feeds back. Wall support, shear field, transport, area coverage and incoming period as in the archived segment. No fit to a late force.

numerical_correction.remedy: Near equilibrium, a direct difference of two forces evaluated on absolute coordinates caused BDF time-step collapse. Both affected workloads were stopped explicitly. The successful calculation evaluates the same nonlinear force difference using increments of bond length and Morse weight. It checks the formula against the ordinary force at finite displacement. The initial attempt did not produce any retained-force measurement.

spatial_refinement_note: The first fine-space jobs stopped at matrix allocation under the 2 GiB address-space cap. Successful refinements use 6 GiB each.
